dct_description_sm: This spatial dataset is the result of a paper evaluating associations between cycling comfort and cycling infrastructure types. It includes Dynamic Comfort Index (DCI) adjusted for cyclist ID and speed, as well as the cluster type (Local Indicator of Spatial Association - LISA), for all the cycleway links surveyed, divided in 25-meter linear units (lixels).
dct_title_s: Dataset for the paper entitled "Bumpy Rides: An Extensive Accelerometer-Based Cycling Infrastructure Survey"
